_about: Source register. Every fact in facts.json must point at one of these. A source with no URL cannot be registered; a fact with no source cannot be loaded. Retrieved 2026-10-11 by automated fetch plus a verification pass; see docs/content-provenance.md for how each was checked and what failed.

sources.publisher: HealthHub, Ministry of Health Singapore (article contributed by NHG Polyclinics)
sources.title: High Blood Pressure: Medication
sources.reuse_note: Government of Singapore site, Ministry of Health Singapore copyright (page footer reads (c) 2026 Ministry of Health Singapore); the article is contributed by NHG Polyclinics. Publisher corrected on 2026-10-11 after an attribution audit found the earlier 'Health Promotion Board' attribution to be wrong. Short paraphrase of factual content only, with attribution. Not presented anywhere in this app as medical advice. Page footer states last reviewed 22 July 2024.

sources.title: Understand Your Medication for Chronic Illness
sources.reuse_note: Government of Singapore site, Ministry of Health Singapore copyright. Short paraphrase only, with attribution. HealthHub patient guidance. NOT an independent authority: this page and S2-healthhub-bp-medication are both HealthHub / Ministry of Health Singapore publications with near-identical drug-class content, so this source is never counted as second corroboration of anything the other one says. It is cited only for what it says in its own right - consult your doctor or pharmacist with questions about your medicines, know what you are taking and why, and keep a written record of your medicines to show your doctor. Correction applied 2026-10-11 after an attribution audit.

sources.title: Normal Blood Pressure: Guidelines for the Elderly
sources.reuse_note: Singapore Heart Foundation (a local charity/voluntary welfare organisation). Short paraphrase with attribution. SCOPE LIMIT, applied 2026-10-11: this page's only smoking content is the treatment step 'Limit the Use of Cigarettes'. It does not state that quitting or not smoking lowers blood pressure, so this source must never be cited for 'not smoking', 'quit smoking' or smoking-cessation claims. It is cited only for the blood-pressure variation note and the advice to measure at home regularly and record the readings for doctor's appointments. The page is addressed to older adults and carries numeric content (a 130/85 figure and 120/80 for people with diabetes or kidney disease); none of that is imported into any fact.
